product_description: Milanote is a visual workspace for organizing creative projects: moodboards, notes, references, tasks and files arranged on a flexible board, shareable with clients and collaborators.
specific_goal: Show filmmakers and designers how visual planning fits the way they already plan client projects.
audience: Filmmakers, video editors, graphic designers and art directors who plan client work visually. They gather references and moodboards, storyboard and shot-list, and juggle scattered feedback, versions and research across tools.

banned_phrases: guaranteed to make you more productive
brand_requirements.raw_tone: Practical, calm, honest and clear. Shows real work in progress rather than selling, and never implies a tool fixes a creative problem on its own.
